dialogue.intro: Reason carefully from the case. Inspect an educator-reviewed fictional case and choose the interpretation or escalation action required by its explicit ordered policy.
dialogue.success: Your decision has a reason behind it. See what it makes possible.
dialogue.tryAgain: This outcome gives you new information. Review the rule and revise your choice.
dialogue.hint: Which detail in the case changes what you should do next?

runtime.runtimeHint: Apply an explicit bounded policy to a supplied case. This runs a prepared decision rule; it does not simulate a live system or establish professional competence.

story.title: Clinical reasoning casebook
story.setting: The evidence archive: An evidence archive has sweeping shelves, brass balconies and reading tables.
story.mission: Compare the supplied observations and authored case rules.
story.payoff: An educational reasoning record scoped to this case
story.transfer: Use the supplied observations and rules to choose your next action.
story.recovery: Compare the observed state with the cited rule before choosing a different action.
story.boundary: The setting and role are fictional. Subject facts come from the cited material; the game does not create missing evidence.
story.guidance: Keep observations, possible actions and supplied consequences separate.
story.reflection: Describe one observation and how the source could guide a decision. Identify anything the source does not establish.
